hero.title: Grievance Redressal Made Simple
hero.body: Lodge your complaint online, through WhatsApp, or by email. Track the status of your grievance at every stage, from submission to verified resolution.

appMockup.complaintTitle: Streetlight not working, Sector 12 main road

howItWorks.subtitle: A clear process from submission to resolution, with full visibility at every step.

report.title: You report it
report.body: Snap a photo, drop a pin, tell us what's wrong. Takes about two minutes.

route.title: We route it
route.body: No guessing which department to call. We figure that out for you, instantly.

assign.title: Someone shows up
assign.body: An officer gets assigned and actually does the work, with photos to prove it.

confirm.title: You confirm it's fixed
confirm.body: Not us saying it's done. You saying it's done.

features.title: Built so complaints can't fall through the cracks
features.body: The system is designed around accountability, not paperwork. Every case is tracked, timed, and closed only when it's genuinely done.

timeBound.title: Time-bound response
timeBound.body: Every complaint carries a deadline. If a department misses it, the case escalates automatically instead of going quiet.

routing.title: Automatic routing
routing.body: Complaints reach the right department the moment they are filed. No forwarding, no dead ends, no "not my desk".

verifiedClosure.title: Citizen-verified closure
verifiedClosure.body: A case is only marked resolved once you confirm it. The department cannot close it on your behalf.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Your contact details stay hidden from public view. Only the assigned officer sees what they need to act on your case.

coverage.title: Every civic issue, one place to report it
coverage.body: If it's a public service, it's covered. Complaints route straight to the department responsible, no need to know who to call.

electricity.title: Electricity
electricity.body: Power outages, faulty meters, exposed wiring, billing disputes.

water.title: Water & Sanitation
water.body: Supply disruptions, leaks, contamination, drainage and sewage issues.

roads.title: Roads & Infrastructure
roads.body: Potholes, broken streetlights, damaged footpaths, traffic signals.

waste.title: Waste Management
waste.body: Missed collections, illegal dumping, overflowing bins, cleanliness.

safety.title: Public Safety
safety.body: Unsafe areas, vandalism, encroachments, accident-prone spots.

municipal.title: Municipal Services
municipal.body: Permits, licenses, property records, building code violations.

mapShowcase.title: Every complaint is pinned to a real location
mapShowcase.body: No more describing "the road near the old bus stop." A GPS pin means officers go straight to the right spot, and departments can spot clusters before they become bigger problems.

resolved.body: Officers submit before-and-after proof. You review it. If it's not actually fixed, it reopens automatically no arguing, no phone calls.

noSelfCert.rest: an officer's word alone never closes a case.

channels.title: File it your way
channels.subtitle: No new app to learn. Reach out however's easiest.

web.title: Web
web.body: Fill a short form, attach a photo, drop a pin. Done in under two minutes.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Message a photo and a line of text to a number you've already got saved.

email.title: Email
email.body: Send it the old-fashioned way. It still gets read and tracked like everything else.

statTicker.caption: Live figures updated in real time as complaints are filed and resolved.

about.body: NivaranSetu started in 2026, built from India, with one goal: make it simple for anyone to report a civic issue and actually see it resolved.

free.question: Is it free to file a complaint?
free.answer: Yes. Filing, tracking, and everything else on NivaranSetu is completely free.

account.question: Do I need an account to file a complaint?
account.answer: Yes. Whether you file on the website, over WhatsApp, or by email, it's tied to your account — that's what lets you track it and get updates later.

resolutionTime.question: How long does it take to get resolved?
resolutionTime.answer: It depends on the category, but every complaint has a target response time. If a department misses it, the case escalates automatically instead of sitting untouched.

verified.question: How do I know it's actually fixed, not just marked closed?
verified.answer: The officer has to submit proof before a case can close, and you get to review it. If it's not actually done, you can reject it and it reopens.

channels.question: Can I file the same complaint through WhatsApp or email instead of the website?
channels.answer: Yes — web, WhatsApp, and email all work the same way. Use whichever is easiest for you.

login.formSubtitle: Pick up right where your last complaint left off.

register.panelBody: File on the web, over WhatsApp, or by email. However you reach out, it lands in the same place, under your name.
register.formSubtitle: Takes about a minute. No paperwork.

verifyEmail.formSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
verifyEmail.successBody: Your account is ready to go.
verifyEmail.errorBody: That code is invalid or has expired.
verifyEmail.missingEmailBody: Register first to get a verification code.

footer.tagline: Report civic issues, track them to resolution, across web, WhatsApp, and email.
